comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kovan MRT about 370 m, Hougang MRT about 1,010 m; closer than 364 of 462 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 11 within 2 km; nearest Xinghua Primary School about 630 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 430 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre about 430 m; nearest park Surin Ave Neighbourhood Park about 780 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Defu MRT about 1,110 m (LTA target 2030) and Serangoon North MRT about 1,400 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 1,260 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 114 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 10 new sales and 774 resales (784 purchases); new sales were 1.3% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Hougang Central (government land sale site, awarded, about 830 homes), about 1,170 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 774 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 290 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 774 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 809 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.3%). Planning-area private resales −7.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
